label: oriental mind
sql: SELECT c.volume_id,c.document_id FROM frus_documents f JOIN document_cache c ON c.rowid=f.rowid WHERE frus_documents MATCH ? AND c.is_front_matter=0 AND c.is_editorial_note=0 AND c.volume_id IN (<scope_volumes.txt>) ORDER BY c.volume_id,c.document_id
